content.short: Funton.ai is a GameFi platform for Telegram and LINE mini apps, tap-to-earn games, and project launch tooling.
content.description: Funton.ai describes itself as an all-in-one tap-to-earn gaming platform for Web3 projects. It offers mini apps on Telegram and LINE, a selection of reward-driven minigames, and GameFi-as-a-Service launch tools for teams that want to publish casual games. All-in-One T2E Gaming Platform for Web3 Projects. ◆ Roadmap Vision for the of Future Funton.ai is committed to Continuous Innovation, Enhancing User Experience, & Driving the Mass Adoption of GameFi. Funton.ai remains a game listing because progression, play, competition, collection, or rewards are the main user activity.
